title: dhammapada
credit: English: course exercise book, after Ācariya Buddharakkhita’s translation of the Dhammapada.

paras.en:
By heedfulness did Maghavā [Indra]
become the foremost of the gods.
They praise heedfulness,
heedlessness is always blamed [despised, criticized].
(Dhp 30)

Like a beautiful flower,
full of color but without fragrance,
even so, fruitless is the good speech
of one who does not act [who does not practise it].
(Dhp 51)

Like a beautiful flower,
full of color and fragrant,
even so, fruitful is the good speech
of one who acts [who practises it].
(Dhp 52)

Long is the night to one who is awake;
long is the league to the weary.
Long is saṃsāra to fools
who do not understand the good Dhamma.
(Dhp 60)
